{{Quote|The ''Jeedai'' killed my clanbrothers and clansisters. We need vengeance on their behalf.|Dejarro|<ref name="Scourge (novel)">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>}}
'''Dejarro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who was a member of the [[Bomu Clan]], a large Rodian clan that was active in the criminal [[Fringer/Legends|fringe]] during the era of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Koax]] hired the Bomu Clan to collect the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of the [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Toro Irana]] on the behalf of her employer, [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera]]. Dejarro delivered the weapon to the Klatooinian in a bazaar on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], and he also informed Koax that [[Mander Zuma|another Jedi]] had investigated a warehouse on Makem Te in which the Bomu Clan had stored a shipment of the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest]], which they had received from Koax's employer. As a punishment for the failure of the Bomu Clan to cover their tracks before the Jedi could arrive, Koax executed Dejarro, by cutting his throat with a [[Knife/Legends|throwing blade]].
